newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Makhteshim in talks to buy foreign firm.
newsitem.headline: Makhteshim in talks to buy foreign firm.

text.p: Israel's Makhteshim Chemicals Works Ltd and its Agan Chemical Manufacturers Ltd subsidiary said on Thursday that they were in talks to acquire an unnamed foreign agro-chemical company.

The two companies, which are controlled by Koor Industries Ltd, said in a statement that they expected to pay approximately $20 million for the company, which markets and distributes crop-protection chemicals and had sales last year of $80 million.
Over the last year the two companies, the world's largest makers of generic argo-chemcials, have undertaken a series of acquisitions in the key export markets of Brazil, Spain and Argentina.
